selection_rule: largest in-row byte span whose adjacent Nd2NzParams column slices are served by one L2 read miss-allocate; measured as the worker count at which added slices stop adding fills
description: CANN FusedInferAttentionScore loads K and V with DataCopy(Nd2NzParams) (fia_block_cube_nonquant_gqa.h CopyKToL1/CopyVToL1 -> CopyKvGmToL1 -> CopySingleMatrixNDToNZ, memory_copy.h). One kv_head occupies head_dim*element_bytes contiguous bytes of a row whose stride is kv_heads*head_dim*element_bytes, and every kv_head of a row is read by the launch. Adjacent slices inside one fill span are served by a single L2 miss-allocate, so the counted fills fall by the number of slices per span. The probe reproduces only that copy geometry; it never executes attention and consumes no production duration.

measurements.note: negative control: a row stride wide enough that the probe's two workers do not cover one span shows no sharing, so the effect is the in-row span and not the worker count

derivation.note: Worker counts beyond slices_per_fill_span add no further sharing: the 128 B slice saturates at 4 workers and the 256 B slice at 2, which fixes the span at 512 B independently of how many AICs are resident.
